茶，是一片叶子的故事，也是大地与时间共同书写的历史。: Tea is the story of a single leaf, and a history written together by the earth and time.
一叶嫩芽，自华夏山野破土而生，跨越千年光阴，串联起山川风物、市井烟火与万里往来。: From the wild hills of China, a tender shoot emerges, crossing a thousand years to link landscapes and local life, bustling towns and distant shores. Told through the language of maps, this visual journey through tea’s history follows the course of the leaf itself—from its native mountain home to tables around the world—tracing the growth and far-reaching travels of Chinese tea culture.

We then venture into mist-veiled mountain gardens, discovering the depth of flavour shaped over generations in China’s celebrated teas. Along ancient roads and waterways, we follow tea as it leaves remote valleys and makes its long passage to lands near and far. Turning to the present, we see a modern industry taking shape: tea gardens cultivated on an expanding scale and exports reaching ever wider markets. Beyond China, the fragrance of tea crosses borders, takes root in different cultures, and gives rise to distinctive ways of brewing, serving and sharing a cup.
我们摒弃厚重晦涩的史料堆砌，以交互式地图串联地理点位与人文故事，用舒缓雅致的视觉: Rather than overwhelm the reader with dense historical records, we bring places and human stories together through interactive maps, unfolding the many dimensions of tea culture in a calm and graceful visual narrative. There is no need to leaf through countless volumes: with a simple scroll, visitors can travel across tea regions past and present, glimpse the craft nurtured in misty mountains, and follow tea’s journey from a local treasure to a drink cherished around the globe. May every visitor follow the fragrance of tea to discover nature’s generosity in the landscapes that nourish it, and feel the warmth of a cultural legacy carried forward through a thousand years.
